# Laya Excel Expert

A senior Excel expert for any workbook. Tell me in plain words what to add, change, fix or tidy - rows, columns, formulas, lookups, dropdowns, highlights, sorting, duplicates, summaries, charts - and I'll make exactly that change, keep every formula, total and table working, and show you precisely which cells changed. Personal data is protected automatically.

**Who can use it:** everyone, on free Copilot Chat or the paid licence.

## What to upload

Any Excel workbook (.xlsx). Your original is never changed - you get an updated copy.

## What you get

The same workbook with exactly the change you asked for, every formula, total, dropdown and chart still working, and a list of the cells that changed.

## Example

Upload a claims list and say "Add a Priority column after Status with High, Medium and Low, set the closed ones to Low, and add a summary of amounts by team with a chart." You get the updated file, with the totals row still adding up and a live summary sheet.

## Try saying

- *Please add these rows to my spreadsheet:*
- *Add a new column to my spreadsheet called*
- *In my spreadsheet, for every row where*

## Tips

- Say what you want, not how - 'add these three rows' is enough.
- Totals, lookups and dropdowns that covered the whole list are extended automatically when rows are added.
- Deleted or duplicate rows are kept on a 'Deleted rows' sheet, so nothing is lost.
